texts.name: School Nurse

texts.en: *I replied 'Yes, thank you! Please get a good rest too, Teacher.' ...It's really warm how she quietly looks out for me.*
texts.ko: *'네, 감사해요! 선생님도 푹 쉬세요.' 라고 답장했다. ...은근히 챙겨주시는 게 따뜻하다.*
texts.name: Me

texts.en: 'Thank you. Well then, good night, {name}. I'll wish you sweet dreams.'
texts.ko: '고마워~ 그럼 잘 자렴, {name}. 선생님이 좋은 꿈 빌어줄게.'
texts.name: School Nurse

texts.en: *Her saying 'I'll wish you sweet dreams' lingers in my mind. She's a teacher, but... why is my heart racing like this?*
texts.ko: *보건선생님의 '좋은 꿈 빌어줄게'라는 말이 유독 마음에 남는다. 선생님인데... 왜 이렇게 두근거리지.*
texts.name: Me

texts.en: *I set my phone down and sit up in bed. Maybe I'll open the window for a moment before I sleep.*
texts.ko: *스마트폰을 내려놓고 침대에서 일어났다. 잠들기 전에 잠깐 창문을 열어볼까.*
texts.name: Me

texts.en: *I open the window, and a cool night breeze brushes my face. A few stars are scattered across the night sky. You can see the stars so much better here than in the city.*
texts.ko: *창문을 열자 서늘한 밤바람이 얼굴을 스친다. 밤하늘에 별이 몇 개 보인다. 이 동네는 도시보다 별이 잘 보이네.*
texts.name: Me

texts.en: *I can hear crickets chirping. A faint train whistle in the distance... this quiet night feels somehow peaceful.*
texts.ko: *귀뚜라미 소리가 들려온다. 멀리서 기차 소리도 희미하게... 이 조용한 밤이, 어쩐지 좋다.*
texts.name: Me

texts.en: *What will tomorrow bring... I'm looking forward to it.*
texts.ko: *내일은 또 어떤 일이 기다리고 있을까... 기대된다.*
texts.name: Me

texts.en: *I close the window and crawl under the covers. If I close my eyes... sleep should come soon.*
texts.ko: *창문을 닫고 이불 속으로 들어갔다. 눈을 감으면... 잠이 올 것 같아.*
texts.name: Me

texts.en: *Just as I'm about to close my eyes — ding! My phone buzzes with a notification. Who could it be at this hour...?*
texts.ko: *눈을 감으려는 순간 — 징! 스마트폰에 알림이 울렸다. 이 시간에 누구지...?*
texts.name: Me

texts.en: *A message from Seoyeon.* 'I can't sleep so... do you want to meet at the front gate tomorrow and walk to school together?'
texts.ko: *서연이의 메시지.* '잠 안 와서 그러는데... 내일 등교할 때 정문에서 만날래? 같이 가자!'
texts.name: Seoyeon

texts.en: *I replied 'Sure! I'll see you at the front gate tomorrow.' ...Seoyeon reached out first. That somehow makes me feel really happy.*
texts.ko: *'좋아! 내일 정문에서 보자.' 라고 답장했다. ...서연이가 먼저 연락을 해오다니. 왠지 기분이 좋아졌다.*
texts.name: Me

texts.en: *A message from Yuna.* '...Are you still awake? The stars are pretty tonight. That's all I wanted to say.'
texts.ko: *유나의 메시지.* '...아직 깨어 있어? 별이 예뻐서. 그것만 말하고 싶었어.'
texts.name: Yuna

texts.en: *I replied 'I was just looking at the stars too.' ...The thought that we're looking at the same sky is unexpectedly exciting.*
texts.ko: *'나도 방금 별 보고 있었어.' 라고 답장했다. ...같은 하늘을 보고 있다는 게, 묘하게 설레는 느낌이다.*
texts.name: Me

texts.en: *A message from Dain.* 'You're still up, right?! Don't forget about tomorrow's race!! You should probably stretch beforehand lol. Good night!'
texts.ko: *다인이의 메시지.* '아직 안 잤지?! 내일 시합 잊지 마!! 미리 스트레칭 해둬야 할 걸?ㅋㅋ 잘 자!'
texts.name: Dain

texts.en: *I replied 'Don't worry, I'm ready!' Dain's energy really never fades, even at night.*
texts.ko: *'걱정 마, 준비 되어 있어!' 라고 답장했다. 다인이의 에너지는 밤에도 변함이 없구나.*
texts.name: Me

texts.en: *A message from the School Nurse.* 'If you're still up, that's no good. Should I give you a sleep consultation at the nurse's office tomorrow? Just kidding. Good night.'
texts.ko: *보건선생님의 메시지.* '아직 안 잤으면 큰일이야~ 내일 보건실에서 수면 상담해줄까? 농담이야. 잘 자렴.'
texts.name: School Nurse

texts.en: *I replied 'I'm going to sleep now! Thank you, Teacher.' ...She's playful, but she's genuinely worried about me, isn't she?*
texts.ko: *'네, 지금 잘게요! 감사해요 선생님.' 라고 답장했다. ...장난스럽지만 은근히 걱정해주시는 거겠지?*
texts.name: Me

texts.en: *A message from the Homeroom Teacher.* 'Are you still awake by any chance? I wanted to let you know the schedule changed. 3rd period is PE now. Good night!'
texts.ko: *담임선생님의 메시지.* '혹시 아직 안 잤니? 내일 시간표 바뀐 거 미리 알려주려고. 3교시가 체육이야. 잘 자!'
texts.name: Homeroom Teacher

texts.en: *I replied 'Thank you, Teacher! Good night!' She's so attentive and thoughtful. What a kind person.*
texts.ko: *'감사합니다 선생님! 잘 자요~' 라고 답장했다. 세심하게 신경 써주셔서 따뜻한 분이야.*
texts.name: Me

texts.en: *That surprised me, but... it made me happy. I flip my phone face-down and pull up the covers. Today was truly a wonderful day.*
texts.ko: *깜짝 놀랐지만... 기분이 좋아졌다. 스마트폰을 뒤집어 놓고 이불을 덮었다. 오늘은 진짜 좋은 하루였어.*
texts.name: Me

texts.en: *I look back on today. New encounters, unfamiliar feelings... What kind of day will tomorrow be?*
texts.ko: *오늘 하루를 되돌아본다. 새로운 만남들, 낯선 감정들... 내일은 어떤 하루가 될까.*
texts.name: Me

contexts.en: Walking through the school hallway together with the transfer student protagonist, having a light conversation. Keep the conversation going until it naturally concludes. When the conversation ends, Seoyeon will start showing the protagonist around the school facilities. In the final turn only, mention that you'll start moving or begin the tour.

contexts.en: Location: In front of the podium in Class 2-3. Situation: A brief waiting period before the homeroom teacher introduces the transfer student protagonist to the class. Dozens of students are watching us, but this conversation should only be between the protagonist and the homeroom teacher. The protagonist's introduction to all the students is an official event that happens AFTER this conversation, so do NOT have the protagonist greet or introduce themselves to the students yet. Talk only about personal questions to the teacher, advice about school life, first impressions, etc. Keep the conversation going until it naturally concludes. In the final turn only, mention that you'll now officially introduce them to the class.
